additional_context: The current build-scope datatype page still publishes the canonical datatype row in source/datatypes.html, and source/fhir.ini routes unlisted datatypes to datatypes.html. Searches found no remaining current source occurrence of the original typo and no Zulip or Confluence evidence changing the straightforward typo conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The combined branch received an empty no-change audit commit because source/datatypes.html already says the canonical type may have a version appended, separated by a vertical bar (|).
